articles.headline: Seahawks' Mike Macdonald says team still believes in RB Jadarian Price
articles.description: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald says the team has not lost faith in starting running back Jadarian Price after the rookie first-round pick lost a fumble for the second week in a row on Sunday.

articles.headline: McVay, Rams won't make excuses after pass interference call
articles.description: A day after his team's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos, Los Angeles coach Sean McVay said the 1-2 Rams will not "play the victim card" because of a debatable defensive pass interference late on cornerback Josh Wallace.
